test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

I have been doing this job __since__ the last five years.
solution:
The correct answer is **'for'.**

***__Key Points__**When we read the sentence, we get to know that the sentence is in **the present perfect continuous tense.**

__
 
• In **Present Perfect Continuous Tense, **we use **since or for** in order to relate the time.
 
• **For should be used with the period of time, for example:**
 
• **1,2,3.... days.**
 
• **1,2,3.... months.**
 
• **1,2,3.... years.**
 
• **Many days, months, years.**

So, there should be the preposition **'for' **instead of **'since'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the usage of **'since'.**

 
• **It must be used with the point of time, for example:**
 
• **Morning, Evening, etc.**
 
• **Sunday, Monday, etc.**
 
• **January, February, etc.**
 
• **1947, 1948, etc.**
 
 
• ***I have been playing cricket since morning.***
 
• **They have been learning English since Monday last.***
